instruction: Could you please set Chrome's JavaScript execution timeout to 60 seconds instead of the default 30 seconds? I work with complex data visualization scripts that sometimes need more time to complete without triggering the 'unresponsive script' warning.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome's JavaScript execution timeout values are hardcoded in the browser's V8 engine and cannot be configured through Chrome settings. The timeout thresholds for detecting unresponsive scripts are determined by Chrome's internal browser architecture and are not user-configurable.
